title: La Vie en Rose
story: Written during the difficult years after World War II, La Vie en Rose became a symbol of hope and love. Édith Piaf's voice transformed a simple love song into an international masterpiece.
fact: The expression 'voir la vie en rose' became a common French phrase meaning to see life with optimism.

title: Ne me quitte pas
story: Jacques Brel wrote this emotional masterpiece about desperation and love. It became one of the most powerful French songs ever recorded.
fact: The song has been translated and performed by many international artists.
